text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I'm so sorry!
I spaced out for a second...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Um... no, it was
a wonderful race! Truly!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I have this strange feeling...
Like I want to see what happens next.
Even though the race is already over.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
So it's finally been decided, hasn't it...
Who the "strongest" is...
For a while after that, Reporter Otonashi gazed blankly at the track.

The "strongest" has been decided...
The reality of it began to truly sink in!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: ...It was a truly wonderful race. Everyone gave it everything they had...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why, as someone who has always cheered for the two of you, it feels bittersweet and a little lonely—"

Reporter Otonashi stared blankly at the track.
She seemed completely out of it, but—
I also had to go check on my partner.

The "strongest" has been decided.
However, our journey is far from over!
